easy.def: A person who does something for fun, not as a job.
examples: He is an amateur painter.
The amateur played well.
She is an amateur.

more.def: A person who does something for enjoyment and not as a paid job.
examples: He is an amateur painter who paints on weekends.
The amateur played in the park.
The amateurs and professionals played on the same field.
The magic trick will amaze you.
Her fast running amazed us.
The big fireworks amaze me.

more.def: To fill someone with great surprise or wonder.
examples: The size of the whale amazed everyone on the boat.
It amazes me how many stars you can see in the desert.
The young chess player amazed the crowd with her skill.
I was amazed.
She was amazed by the trick.
He looked amazed.

more.def: Filled with great surprise and wonder.
examples: I was amazed by the magic trick.
She was amazed at how tall the tree was.
The kids looked amazed at the huge cake.
The magic show was amazing.
What an amazing view!
She did an amazing jump.

more.def: So surprising or wonderful that it is hard to believe.
examples: The acrobats did amazing flips.
The view from the mountain top was amazing.
It is amazing how fast a cheetah can run.

easy.def: A person who represents their country in another country.
examples: The ambassador met the king.
The ambassador lives abroad.
The ambassador gave a speech.

more.def: A person chosen to represent their country in another country.
examples: The ambassador met with the leaders of the other country.
She served as ambassador for three years.
The ambassador gave a speech in French.
The amber is shiny.
She wore an amber necklace.
Amber is golden.

more.def: A hard, clear, yellow-brown substance that is made from the sap of ancient trees.
examples: The insect was trapped in a piece of amber.
Tiny bubbles were frozen inside the amber.
Amber glows golden in the sunlight.
The light is amber.
The traffic light turned amber.
The leaves turned amber.

more.def: A color that is a mix of yellow and orange.
examples: The room glowed with amber light from the lamp.
The leaves turned a deep amber in autumn.
The honey was a clear amber color.

easy.def: A big goal that you want to reach.
examples: Her ambition is to be a doctor.
He has big ambition.
My ambition is to fly.

more.def: A strong wish to do or become something important.
examples: Her ambition is to be a doctor when she grows up.
He has the ambition to run in the Olympics.
Her ambition to build a robot kept her studying every night.

easy.def: A truck that takes hurt people to the hospital.
examples: The ambulance came fast.
An ambulance has a siren.
The ambulance took her to the hospital.

more.def: A special vehicle that carries sick or hurt people to a hospital.
examples: The ambulance raced to the hospital with its siren on.
Cars pulled over to let the ambulance go by.
The helpers in the ambulance cared for the hurt man.

easy.def: A word said at the end of a prayer.
examples: They said amen at the end.
The class said amen together.
We all said amen.

more.def: A word used at the end of a prayer that means "may it be so."
examples: The people said amen when the prayer was over.
Everyone in the church said amen together.
He bowed his head and said amen.

easy.def: A change or addition to a law or rule.
examples: The amendment changed the rule.
We read an amendment.
The class voted on the amendment.

more.def: A change or addition made to a law, rule or piece of writing.
examples: The class voted for an amendment to the rules of the game.
The First Amendment to the Constitution protects free speech.
The mayor added an amendment to the town's new law.
The house stood amid the trees.
Amid the noise, she heard it.
He smiled amid the crowd.

more.def: In the middle of, or surrounded by.
examples: The house stood amid tall trees.
Amid the noise, I heard my name.
He sat calmly amid the chaos.

easy.def: In the middle of a group.
examples: The cat was among the toys.
She sat among her friends.
A tree among many trees.

more.def: In the middle of or surrounded by a group of things.
examples: The cat hid among the boxes.
She sat among her friends at lunch.
A small cottage stood among the trees.
The cat hid amongst the flowers.
He stood amongst friends.
We sat amongst the trees.

more.def: Surrounded by, or in the group of.
examples: The treasure was hidden amongst old books.
He stood amongst his friends.
We found the lost toy amongst the leaves.

easy.def: How much there is of something.
examples: Add a small amount of salt.
A large amount of snow fell.
I saved a big amount of money.

more.def: The total quantity of something, how much of it there is.
examples: Use a tiny amount of glue so the paper does not wrinkle.
A huge amount of water flows over the falls each second.
The amount of homework changes from week to week.
The story is amusing.
The clown was amusing.
It was an amusing show.
The clown's tricks were amusing.
She told an amusing story about her dog.
The cartoon was amusing for kids.
